noteD.text:
Both modes, everywhere
• Header switch: Light · Dark · Auto. Auto follows your phone or computer setting and flips live at sunset if your system does.
• Every face and state is shown in both rows.
• Horizon shows a night sky in dark and a day sky in light; in Auto it follows the real time of day.
• Press Play on any board: countdown, faces, presets and the theme switch all work.

noteMotion.text:
Motion
• Ring: glowing tip travels back, soft light sweep.
• Bold: bar drains with slow shimmer.
• Horizon: sun sets as the session ends; clouds, stars, glinting water.
• Tide: water drains with waves and bubbles.
• Tabs, presets and the theme switch slide. Reduced motion turns it all off.

noteTime.text:
Time you can read at a glance
• Saturday, 26 September 2026 · 10:00 PM at the top.
• All times in AM/PM. Times past midnight say tomorrow.
• Ready shows when it would end before you start.
